fields.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
fields.note: All elements of the requirement (at-fault and no-fault causes, notice and cure period, relocation assistance or rent waiver, and the notice to tenants before December 19, 2021 or at lease commencement or renewal) appear in the document.

fields.quoted_span: Under a no-fault just cause termination, the owner shall either provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive payment of rent for the final 3 months of the tenancy.
fields.note: The 30-day threshold, the notice and opportunity to cure, and the 3-month relocation assistance or rent waiver are all stated in the document.

fields.quoted_span: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.
fields.note: The date matches 2021-11-19. The document does not give the adoption date, only 'Tuesday night', which the rule acknowledges.

fields.quoted_span: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.
fields.note: The document confirms the ordinance was adopted with a Nov 19, 2021 effective date. It does not state that the ordinance is currently in force, although the page's recent-news items are dated 2026.

fields.quoted_span: The Just Cause Ordinance shall not apply to certain types of residential property, including housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.
fields.note: The exemptions and the 30-day tenancy threshold match the document. The 15-year window has no stated reference date, which the rule also records. The word 'including' means the exemption list may not be exhaustive.

fields.quoted_span: Santa Ana City Council adopts rent stabilization and just cause eviction ordinances, effective Nov. 19 - City of Santa Ana
fields.note: The document names the 'Just Cause Eviction Ordinance' but gives no code section or ordinance number. The aliases such as 'Santa Ana JCO' are not in the document.
